text: A tripod secures the camera and maintains stability, serving as the foundation of quality photography. One may utilize natural illumination, a flash unit, or a studio arrangement for lighting needs. Attention must be paid to managing these light sources so that neither deep shadows nor blown-out highlights appear. Achieving correct exposure remains essential for ensuring visual balance within the final picture. Finally, photographers must master compositional techniques and equilibrium to produce images that engage the viewer aesthetically.
